Prepare Docker, local compose where useful, environment configuration, CI/CD and Azure deployment. Recommended production components: Angular hosting/CDN, ASP.NET Core API, Worker, Azure SQL, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Key Vault and Application Insights. Pipeline: restore -> build -> tests -> security checks -> container -> staging -> smoke tests -> approval -> production. Never commit secrets.
